description: The model's metadata key-value store (GGUF) or __metadata__ block (safetensors). Large arrays arrive as {count, sample} summaries and long strings are truncated, so tokenizer vocabularies can't flood the context. Filter keys by substring (e.g. 'tokenizer' or 'rope').

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to filter metadata keys

path.description: Path to a .gguf or .safetensors file, a *.safetensors.index.json, or a model directory

name: get_metadata
title: Get model metadata
